What's New in Version 1.42 🚀⚡

  • Increased Anthropic Output token limit

What's New in Version 1.60

  • Added support for Parakeet v2 and v3 models (requires re-download)
  • Added support for Soniox v3 model
  • Added claude 4.5 haiku model
  • Toggleable Command + E functionality
  • Redesigned the dashboard
  • Removed the power mode UI by default (turn it on from settings)
  • Removed activated power mode persistence
  • Improved support for getting selected text
  • Rewrote the default prompts
  • Minor Improvements and fixes
